description: [STABLE] Import Scrivener External Folder Sync Draft files into this server's WRITING_SYNC_DIR by generating scene sidecars and reconciling by Scrivener binder ID. This is the recommended default path for first-time setup before sync().

auto_sync.description: If true (default), runs sync() after import when not dry-run.

dry_run.description: If true, reports planned writes without changing files.

ignore_patterns.description: Array of regex patterns matched against filenames. Files matching any pattern are excluded from import. Useful to skip fragments, beat-sheet notes, or feedback files.

preflight.description: If true, returns a list of files that would be processed without doing any work. Use to verify scope before a large import.

project_id.description: Project ID override (e.g. 'the-lamb'). Defaults to a slug derived from WRITING_SYNC_DIR.

source_dir.description: Path to Scrivener external sync folder (the folder that contains Draft/, or Draft/ itself).

name: import_scrivener_sync
